name: Suzlon Energy Ltd
tagline: Completed debt-free turnaround with a large domestic wind order book (6.1 GW) and a capital-light DevCo model now driving ~60% of new FY27 orders - a genuine named inflection for a large-cap, but two straight quarters of YoY margin compression and PAT decline (Q4 FY26, Q1 FY27) temper the growth story even as the structural turnaround holds.
business_overview: Suzlon Energy is India's largest domestic wind turbine OEM (manufacturing, EPC and O&M), historically debt-laden through the mid-2010s to early 2020s, now past a multi-year balance-sheet restructuring. Now executing a 'Suzlon 2.0' re-segmentation into RE Tech, RE DevCo, RE Projects and RE AMS units, with new turbine platforms (S175, S163) and international expansion plans. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@rdkriplani, bullish view, medium conviction, 2026-09-13).
fundamentals_table: FY26 revenue +54% YoY to Rs 16,679 Cr; but YoY growth rate decelerating (Q4 FY26 +45%, Q1 FY27 +23%)
Near debt-free: borrowings ~Rs 556 Cr vs net cash ~Rs 2,384 Cr; net worth ~Rs 9,869 Cr

EBITDA margin compressing: Q4 FY25 18.4% -> Q4 FY26 17.6% -> Q1 FY26 19.2% -> Q1 FY27 15.6% (mgmt cites Suzlon 2.0 upfront investment + Middle-East-linked supply-chain disruption deferring 10-20% of deliveries)
PAT declined YoY in the last two reported quarters despite revenue growth: Q4 FY26 PAT Rs 1,114 Cr (-5.7% YoY); Q1 FY27 PAT Rs 305 Cr (-6% YoY)

~6.1 GW order book; ~1.1 GW new orders booked in FY27 so far (84% PSU/C&I), ~60% via the DevCo (asset-light) model; 3 DevCo-led orders confirmed by Sep 2026 (Waaree 201.6MW Andhra Pradesh, Torrent Green Energy 250MW, Ayana Renewable 200MW Madhya Pradesh); record Q1 FY27 deliveries (506 MW, +14% YoY)
Stock P/E ~18.8x trailing; one third-party FY28 EPS estimate (~Rs 2.37) is barely above FY26 run-rate EPS (~Rs 2.32), implying near-flat 2-yr consensus EPS growth
Promoter holding 11.7% (down from 13.28% Sep-2023), gradual dilution not distress; pledge nil/flat throughout; FII ~24%, retail ~53-55%; no dividend paid despite strong ROE/ROCE
fundamentals_narrative: Suzlon has completed a genuine, named structural turnaround: from chronically debt-laden to a near-debt-free balance sheet (~Rs 2,384 Cr net cash, ~Rs 9,869 Cr net worth), with trailing ROCE/ROE at 34%/40% and a large domestic order book (~6.1 GW) increasingly sourced via the capital-light DevCo model (~60% of new FY27 orders, 3 DevCo-led orders confirmed by Sep 2026). This deep-dive pass surfaces a real tempering fact the light pass missed: EBITDA margin has compressed for two straight quarters (18.4%->17.6%->19.2%->15.6% YoY through Q1 FY27) and PAT has actually declined YoY in both Q4 FY26 (-5.7%) and Q1 FY27 (-6%), even as revenue kept growing (45%, then 23% YoY) - management attributes this to Suzlon 2.0 upfront investment plus Middle-East-linked supply-chain disruption deferring 10-20% of deliveries. At ~18.8x trailing P/E, the market is not obviously overpaying, but a lone third-party FY28 EPS estimate (~Rs 2.37) implies near-flat 2-year EPS growth, consistent with the margin-compression signal rather than a clean acceleration story. At a ~Rs 59,000 Cr market cap, a literal 10x (to ~Rs 6 lakh Cr) or 100x is not a credible framing regardless of operating strength - this is a large-cap turnaround/growth compounder, not an early-stage small-cap, and the near-term earnings print now needs to prove the margin dip is transient rather than structural.

bull_case: Completed, named turnaround: near-debt-free balance sheet, ROCE ~34%/ROE ~40%, from a historically debt-laden position
Large, growing order book (~6.1 GW) with a capital-light DevCo model now sourcing ~60% of new FY27 orders; 3 DevCo-led orders confirmed by Sep 2026 across 2 states
Record Q1 FY27 deliveries (506 MW, +14% YoY) - genuine operating momentum on the volume side
Valuation (~18.8x trailing P/E) not stretched relative to the trailing growth/return profile
Suzlon 2.0 re-segmentation (RE Tech/DevCo/Projects/AMS) and new turbine platforms (S175/S163) are an explicit capability-ladder move, not just guidance language
bear_case: EBITDA margin has compressed for two straight quarters (19.2%->15.6% YoY in Q1 FY27) and PAT has declined YoY in both of the last two reported quarters (Q4 FY26 -5.7%, Q1 FY27 -6%) despite strong revenue growth - the headline growth narrative is not yet flowing through to earnings
A lone third-party FY28 EPS estimate (~Rs 2.37) is barely above FY26 run-rate EPS (~Rs 2.32), implying the market/analysts may already expect near-flat 2-year EPS growth
At ~Rs 59,000 Cr market cap, a literal 10x/100x framing is not credible regardless of fundamentals - large-cap compounder, not an early-stage small-cap
No dividend paid despite strong ROE/ROCE - a soft capital-allocation/shareholder-returns gap
Wind-order cyclicality, import/component supply-chain exposure (explicitly cited by management this quarter) and dependence on continued domestic renewable policy support remain structural risks
verdict_headline: Large-cap wind OEM with a completed, named debt-free turnaround and a capital-light DevCo order model, but a fresh deep-dive finds two consecutive quarters of YoY margin compression and PAT decline that temper the growth story - four_box still 3.5 (analyst_override on thesis_fit), conviction moved from Medium-High to Medium on the margin signal.
